reviews.review_text:
Keith S
22 contributions

Try it! Nice change from Vietnamese food
Feb 2018 • Couples
Went for dinner and was surprised by the extensive menu. Ended up going for a sashimi set and also a crab egg salad.

The yellow herring and shima saba (mackerel) were the highlights - very tasty. The salmon and tuna were a bit of a letdown but still not too bad.

Crab egg salad was lovely though! It is a little pricey compared to Vietnamese restaurants but if you dont mind that then the food and atmosphere is a nice change from the hectic Old Quarter.

Just forget about this place
Aug 2013 • Couples
That's the worst place ever! 
First of all, we get there during the night 10 minutes before 10 pm. The staff told us that the restaurant was getting closed so we couldn't get inside to eat. The whole thing is that it's written on the door "closed at 10:30 pm"...
The day after, my girlfriend and I really wanted to eat Japanese food so we decided to get back to this restaurant and I just wanna say something: that's the worst experience ever for many reasons.
Crappy food, the staff was really really bad and the worst thing is that taxes were not include in the price. So finally get 10% more on the bill which you were not expecting at all.
If you wanna spend your money and have empty stomach at the end (me) and the feeling to through up (my girlfriend), HERE IS THE PLACE TO BE!
